title: GenCon 2026
excerpt: largest board game convention in America.
body:
Last weekend(7/31~8/2), I had a chance to visit GenCon 2026 with my siblings and their family friends. It was the first-ever convention I've been to, and I loved the short time I had there.

## Delta Flight (SJC -> ATL, ATL -> IND)

For this particular trip, I had flown a flight with Delta on a Thursday night to arrive on Friday morning. 

It was my first with Delta, and previously I've flown United and AA. This Delta flight pampered me, as I got free in-flight wifi and their in-flight entertainment tablet that has **limited** youtube, crunchyroll, music, and movies. 

In addition, they also provide free drinks and a snack after departure (if destination > 350 miles). 

The three-hour time difference between California and Indiana made the overnight flight somewhat unbearable, as I had only gotten 2 hours of sleep across 36 hours. My first flight was from approximately 10pm to 2am PT, but it was around 5pm when I landed in Georgia. I then boarded a 7am connecting flight and arrived in Indiana at around 9am.

## The Convention

### 7/31 

I arrived at the convention center, met up with my siblings and a friend, and proceeded into the exhibition hall (with my carry-on) for the various booths and board game tables. The place was massive and filled to the brim with people. I recorded my reactions with my **Osmo Pocket 3** gimbal but ended up losing the case and decided to leave my suitcase in the trunk of our ride home for convenience.

We had a mini photoshoot at the skywalk for my sister and her friend and went to an American diner to meet up with more family friends and had a quick meal there as well.

After, we played our first board game, Cartographers and Altay right before heading back at 9 pm and sleeping in.

### 8/1 🌧

I came out with my sister's cosplay, not sure the name but we left out the blonde wig bc it does not fit my asian face, haha.. 

Then, we walked over to the Lucas Oil Stadium with food trucks and vendors outside passing by pinball machines. Previously I've seen the outside of the stadium and it looks amazing on the inside with race cars and overall design.

Walking back, there were pinball machines (of movies) across the halls and we finished visiting the exhibition hall that we missed the day before. 

We also got gnome hats from Get Gnomed just to find each other through the crowd.

I missed today's morning game Distilled, but the rest of the day I finished off with 4 games ().

### 8/2 🌧

packed up the luggage left the house for our morning Animal Kingdom game at 10am that lasted for 2 hours before going to getting free die from Crystal Castle with a coupon book from our badge, kinda a quest we had to get a free souvenir.

Spent some time with sister's cosplayers before leaving to take my flight.

## Delta Flight (IND -> LAX, LAX -> SJC)

Indiana airport is so pretty and is ranked the best as a mid-sized airport. I loved the view of the planes and the layout of food stores and sitting spaces. 

Watched Mulan and Project Hail Mary (halfway).
